title: Phase 2: Repository layer (4 repos + base + tests)
description: Build the async repository layer on top of the Phase 1 FusekiClient. Deliverables: src/graph/repositories/base_repository.py (shared SPARQL helpers, prefix constants, literal escaping, binding helpers), intent_repository.py (create/get/list/update/delete + write_state_change), intent_report_repository.py, intent_spec_repository.py, hub_repository.py, tests/unit/test_repositories.py. SPARQL rules: INSERT DATA for create, SELECT+OPTIONAL for get, COUNT(*) + LIMIT/OFFSET for list, DELETE/INSERT WHERE for update, DROP GRAPH for delete. No RDFLib in production code. Mocked with respx.
close_reason: 59/59 tests passing, 98% coverage. All 5 repository files delivered: base_repository (helpers), intent_repository (create/get/list/update/delete/write_state_change), intent_report_repository, intent_spec_repository, hub_repository. SPARQL rules followed: INSERT DATA for create, SELECT+OPTIONAL for get, COUNT(*)+LIMIT/OFFSET for list, DELETE/INSERT WHERE for update, ASK+DROP for delete. expressionValue stored as opaque xsd:string, deserialized back to dict for JsonLdExpression.

title: Phase 1: Fuseki graph layer (namespaces, nodes, store, schema_init)
description: Build the async Jena/Fuseki SPARQL-over-HTTP client layer for the TMF921 API. Deliverables per docs/09-deliverables.md: src/graph/namespaces.py (namespace constants + named graph URIs), src/graph/nodes.py (URI constructor functions), src/graph/store.py (FusekiClient async httpx class + module singleton), src/graph/schema_init.py (async Fuseki init helpers). Tests in tests/unit/test_store.py using respx to mock HTTP — no live Fuseki required. Must reach ≥80% coverage of src/graph/.
close_reason: All 41 Phase 1 tests passing, 100% coverage of src/graph/ (namespaces, nodes, store, schema_init). Fuseki SPARQL-over-HTTP client fully implemented with respx-mocked tests.
